reason: ESCAPE-TRD-type trial (PMC OA): adults 18-64 with MDD and non-response to >=2 antidepressants. Served observed-case arm means printed in the full-text table: -10.1 (SD 10.80, n 109) vs -8.1 (SD 10.26, n 106). The extractor's SET_ASIDE (no CI for the raw MD) is rejected: the served estimand is computed from arm means. FAS = randomised with at least one dose of each drug (mITT), which matches the served label.
reviewed_note: PMID 37025256 (NCT03434041; PMC OA), esketamine vs intranasal placebo, each with a new oral antidepressant: adults 18-64 with MDD and non-response to >=2 antidepressants. Served observed-case arm means printed in the full-text table: -10.1 (SD 10.80, n 109) vs -8.1 (SD 10.26, n 106). The extractor's SET_ASIDE (no CI for the raw MD) is rejected: the served estimand is computed from arm means. FAS = randomised with at least one dose of each drug (mITT), which matches the served label. (Corrected: an earlier note misnamed this trial 'ESCAPE-TRD-type'; ESCAPE-TRD is a quetiapine-controlled trial.)

population.span: The study population included adults aged 18–64 years, who met the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 5th Edition (DSM-5) criteria for single-episode MDD or recurrent MDD without psychotic features, based on clinical assessment and confirmed by the Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview (MINI).

endpoint.span: The primary endpoint was change in MADRS total score (7-day recall) from baseline to Day 28 (end of double-blind treatment phase).

estimate.span: Change from baseline to Day 28 N 109 106 Mean (SD) −10.1 (10.80) −8.1 (10.26)

analysis_set.span: The efficacy analysis set (ie, full analysis set), included all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication and 1 dose of oral AD medication during the double-blind treatment phase.

treatment_strategy.span: A computer-generated randomization schedule was used to randomly assign patients in a 1:1 ratio to receive double-blind treatment with either intranasal esketamine or matching placebo, each in combination with a newly initiated open-label oral AD.

follow_up.span: The primary endpoint was change in MADRS total score (7-day recall) from baseline to Day 28 (end of double-blind treatment phase).

entry_population_reading.span: Only patients with non-response to at least 2 AD treatments prior to randomization were eligible to participate in the study.

entry_population.extractor_why: The entry population comprised adults aged 18–64 with MDD and nonresponse to at least two antidepressant treatments, consistent with the question's adult TRD population.
